rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a long, slender pole or rod used as a support or structural object.

example.english: This pole is too long to fit in the rack.
example.traditional: 呢支桿太長，放唔入個架。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 gon2 taai3 coeng4 fong3 m4 jap6 go3 gaa2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a basic fishing rod rather than a general-purpose pole.

example.english: I bought a fishing pole and went to the seaside to fish.
example.traditional: 我買咗支魚竿去海邊釣魚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 jyu4 gon1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 diu3 jyu4

rows.note: Use this for the two Earth poles as a pair, or for two opposed extremes; it does not mean every kind of pole.

example.english: The weather at either Earth pole is very different.
example.traditional: 南北兩極嘅天氣好唔同。
example.jyutping: naam4 bak1 loeng5 gik6 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this in motor racing for the starting position at the front of the grid.

example.english: We started from pole position in this race.
example.traditional: 我哋今場賽車由桿位出發。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 coi3 ce1 jau4 gon2 wai2 ceot1 faat3
